sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: This sounds really far from Super Mario Bros., where it's like, ding, ding, ding, like getting from one, you know, chapter of the story to the other.
sentences.zh: 这听起来跟《超级马力欧兄弟》差得很远，那种游戏就像是“叮、叮、叮”，你知道的，就像是从故事的一个章节进入另一个章节。

sentences.en: But you're living in a very confined space in that old version of video games.
sentences.zh: 但在老版本的电子游戏中，你生活在一个非常狭小的空间里。

sentences.en: Yeah, and then you're not going from left to right in this game.
sentences.zh: 对，而且在这个游戏里，你不是从左走到右。

sentences.zh: 你可以去任何你想去的地方。

sentences.zh: 你正在开创一种名为沙盒游戏的新游戏类型，在这里你拥有绝对的自由。

sentences.en: You can follow the story missions if you want, but you could also just go off on your own.

sentences.zh: 你的犯罪城堡。

sentences.zh: 而且我相信我们已经表达过这一点，但这确实值得强调。

sentences.en: Everything that's happening in this game, it sounds like almost definitionally, is criminal or not good.
sentences.zh: 这个游戏里发生的一切，从定义上听起来几乎都是犯罪行为或者是不好的事。

sentences.en: Well, let's not oversimplify things, Michael.
sentences.zh: 好了，迈克尔，我们别把事情过度简化了。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: But I would say that, like, it's coming at you from this, like, Hobbesian idea of freedom, where, like, everyone is their worst selves.
sentences.zh: 但我想说的是，它源于一种霍布斯式的自由理念，也就是每个人都展现出最坏的自己。

sentences.en: Their basest self, yeah.
sentences.zh: 他们最卑劣的自我，没错。

sentences.en: And I can't overstate, like, that was really strange in 2001 to play a game where, like, you would be walking down the street in this game as your character,
sentences.zh: 而且我怎么强调都不为过，在2001年玩这样一款游戏真的很奇怪，在这个游戏里，你操控角色走在街上，

sentences.en: and a non-playable character would be walking by you and just automatically say, like, you're fat.
sentences.zh: 非玩家角色从你身边走过，就会直接自动说出诸如“你真胖”之类的话。

sentences.zh: 你后脖子看起来就像一包热狗。

sentences.zh: 就像这样，这太让人震惊了。

sentences.en: And then, of course, you have the ability to respond.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然了，你也有能力做出回应。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 我要吃掉你，笨蛋。

sentences.en: I recall that when this game became part of the American zeitgeist, that dimension of it became very controversial very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我记得当这款游戏成为美国时代精神的一部分时，它的那个维度很快就引发了极大的争议。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But it was also coming at a moment of moral panic, right?
sentences.zh: 但它也正值一场道德恐慌时期，对吧？

sentences.en: This is after the September 11th terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 这是在“9·11”恐怖袭击之后。

sentences.en: This was during a time where there were a lot of questions of sort of violence among us.
sentences.zh: 当时社会上充斥着关于我们之中存在大量暴力的种种疑问。

sentences.en: There was a domineering perspective, although the research didn't support it, that playing violent games...
sentences.zh: 当时有一种盛行的观点，尽管研究并不支持它，即玩暴力游戏……

sentences.en: Would inspire violence.
sentences.zh: 会激发暴力。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It doesn't take a massive leap of the imagination to think of the school council board president who says, I don't like this.
sentences.zh: 要想想到那些说“我讨厌这个”的学校理事会主席，根本不需要费多大想象力。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And certainly a lot of them did.
sentences.zh: 而且确实有很多人这么做了。

sentences.en: I mean, in 2002, when Grand Theft Auto Vice City came out, which was set in this fictional version of Miami, there were multiple lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在2002年《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》发售时——该作以虚构版本的迈阿密为背景——引发了多起诉讼。

sentences.en: But if you want to talk about controversy in Grand Theft Auto, you have to talk about the hot coffee incident.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想谈论《侠盗猎车手》中的争议，就不得不提“热咖啡”事件。

sentences.en: Take me back to my place.
sentences.zh: 带我回我的住处。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I will bite.
sentences.zh: 我接茬。

sentences.en: Tell me about the hot coffee incident in the history of GTA.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲GTA历史上的“热咖啡”事件。

sentences.en: Well, can I just tell you in terms of my own personal history with Grand Theft Auto, I learned about this when I was like, I must have been 11 or 12.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我能跟你说说我个人与《侠盗猎车手》的历史吗？我了解这件事的时候大约11或12岁吧。

sentences.en: And I was sitting with my grandfather, who was reading the Wall Street Journal, and just placed the newspaper in front of me and said, look at this.
sentences.zh: 当时我正和祖父坐在一起，他在读《华尔街日报》，然后把报纸往我面前一放，说：“看看这个。”

sentences.en: You play video games.
sentences.zh: 你玩电子游戏。

sentences.en: This is why they're bad and will turn you, like, violent.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它们不好，会让你变得暴力。

sentences.en: You want to have some coffee?
sentences.zh: 你想喝杯咖啡吗？

sentences.en: The hot coffee incident came from a part of the game that developers had put in into Grand Theft Auto San Andreas.
sentences.zh: “热咖啡”事件源于开发者在《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》中加入游戏的一部分。

sentences.en: The developers had created this simulated sex scene for the game.
sentences.zh: 开发者为游戏制作了这个模拟性爱场景。

sentences.en: And then last minute, they decided, you know, better not to put that in.
sentences.zh: 但最后一分钟，他们觉得，你知道的，还是别放进去了。

sentences.en: So they took it out.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把它删除了。

sentences.en: Even for us, be on the bell.
sentences.zh: 甚至对我们来说，也要小心谨慎。

sentences.en: Even for us, let's not do it.
sentences.zh: 甚至对我们来说，还是别这么做了。

sentences.en: And they took it out of the official game, but they left the code in the game.
sentences.zh: 他们把它从正式游戏中删除了，但代码留在了游戏里。

sentences.en: If you have hot coffee, your DADC matrix number is PDFs.
sentences.zh: 如果你有热咖啡，你的DADC矩阵编号就是PDF。

sentences.en: You know, skilled gamers who understand code could still find the simulated sex scene in the game, and they could figure out how to play it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，懂代码的技术高超的玩家仍然能在游戏中找到这个模拟性爱场景，并且他们能弄清楚怎么玩。

sentences.en: And once they did, they spread the word around.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们做到了，就把消息传开了。

sentences.en: How could you not?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能不呢？

sentences.en: How could you not?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能不呢？

sentences.en: Everyone knows about the hot coffee controversy involving Rockstar Games.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知道涉及Rockstar Games的“热咖啡”争议。

sentences.en: And so suddenly you have all these people playing a scene that was not intended in the game.
sentences.zh: 于是突然之间，所有这些人都在玩一个本不属于游戏中的场景。

sentences.en: Or maybe was, because the code was left.
sentences.zh: 或者也许本来就是，因为代码留下了。

sentences.en: Well, at one point, at one point it was certainly intended.
sentences.zh: 嗯，曾经有一段时间，它绝对是故意留下的。

sentences.en: This is sort of like alights with already these fears about violence in video games.
sentences.zh: 这有点契合了人们对电子游戏中暴力的既有恐惧。

sentences.en: Now you have sex in video games.
sentences.zh: 现在电子游戏里又有了性。

sentences.en: And now you have the Federal Trade Commission asking you questions.
sentences.zh: 然后联邦贸易委员会（FTC）开始找你麻烦了。

sentences.en: Also politicians are using the hot coffee scandal as a way to renew calls for legislation to regulate the sale of games to minors, and potentially even have the government...
sentences.zh: 政客们也在利用“热咖啡”丑闻，以此重新呼吁立法，规范向未成年人销售游戏的行为，甚至可能让政府……

sentences.en: But Congress was upset about, and what senators like Hillary Clinton were upset about, was that they felt like the companies had misled the ratings agencies.
sentences.zh: 但国会感到不满的，以及像希拉里·克拉顿这样的参议员感到不满的是，他们觉得这些公司欺骗了评级机构。

sentences.en: That was the important part.
sentences.zh: 这才是关键所在。

sentences.en: The fact that you could access a simulated sex scene meant that the game should have had a higher rating.
sentences.zh: 你能接触到一个模拟性爱场景这一事实，意味着这款游戏本该获得更高的评级。

sentences.en: Well, last week, Hillary Clinton introduced legislation that would fine retailers up to $5,000 if they sell an M or AL rated game to a minor.
sentences.zh: 嗯，上周，希拉里·克林顿提出了一项立法，如果零售商将M级或AO级的游戏卖给未成年人，将面临高达5000美元的罚款。

sentences.en: Now, in addition to Clinton...
sentences.zh: 现在，除了克林顿……

sentences.en: What does this controversy do to the sales of a game whose developers seem to know quite well the power of the illicit?
sentences.zh: 这场争议对一款其开发者似乎非常清楚禁忌之力的游戏来说，销量有何影响？

sentences.en: Well, what do you think?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: The sales go up.
sentences.zh: 销量飙升。

sentences.en: They do have to settle some lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 他们确实不得不达成一些诉讼和解。

sentences.en: They make an undisclosed settlement with the FTC through Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们与通过国会的FTC达成了未公开金额的和解。

sentences.en: But the sales are going through the roof.
sentences.zh: 但销量简直一路冲天。

sentences.en: Every single game in the Grand Theft Auto series makes more money than the laSt.
sentences.zh: 《侠盗猎车手》系列的每一部新作都比上一部赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: And how much money are we talking about for these games?
sentences.zh: 我们究竟在讨论这些游戏能赚多少钱？

sentences.en: So why don't we look at Grand Theft Auto 4, which came out in 2008.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来看看2008年发售的《侠盗猎车手4》。

sentences.en: God bless this city!
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑这座城市！

sentences.en: It sold 3.6 million copies in one day.
sentences.zh: 它在一天内售出了360万份。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then the sales hit $6 million globally in the first week for a total haul of $500 million.
sentences.zh: 然后在第一周，全球销量达到600万份，总收入高达5亿美元。

sentences.en: That's one week.
sentences.zh: 那可是一周时间。

sentences.en: That's extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这太非同寻常了。

sentences.en: The trend continues.
sentences.zh: 这种趋势仍在继续。

sentences.en: Later on, Grand Theft Auto 5 comes out.
sentences.zh: 后来，《侠盗猎车手5》发售了。

sentences.en: I always thought I was the good guy.
sentences.zh: 我总觉得自己是个好人。

sentences.en: God help the morally bad.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑道德败坏之人。

sentences.en: This is more successful than anyone could have predicted.
sentences.zh: 这比任何人预期的都要成功。

sentences.en: In 24 hours, the game made more than $800 million.
sentences.zh: 在24小时内，这款游戏的收入超过了8亿美元。

sentences.en: In three days, it hit the billion-dollar mark.
sentences.zh: 在三天内，它达到了十亿美元的里程碑。

sentences.en: It's a video game that is shattering sales records.
sentences.zh: 这是一款正在打破销售记录的电子游戏。

sentences.en: That is to say...
sentences.zh: 也就是说……

sentences.en: Never has there been an opening like this in the entertainment industry.
sentences.zh: 娱乐业从未有过这样的开局。

sentences.en: Bigger than movies, sporting events, and concerts.
sentences.zh: 比电影、体育赛事和音乐会还要盛大。

sentences.en: Here's a little look at GTA 5.
sentences.zh: 这里简单看一下《GTA 5》。

sentences.en: What you're describing sound like the ingredients for a very successful game.
sentences.zh: 你所描述听起来像是成就一款极成功游戏的各项要素。

sentences.en: But put your finger, if you can, on why you think this is a transcendent blockbuster of a video game, which it clearly is.
sentences.zh: 但如果可以的话，你认为为什么这是一款超越时代的轰动级电子游戏——它显然是——请试着指出其中的原因。

sentences.en: I think to answer that, you have to understand that the tone of this game is so unique.
sentences.zh: 我想为了回答这个问题，你必须明白这款游戏的基调是如此独特。

sentences.en: The idea that the whole series has its roots in controversy.
sentences.zh: 整个系列的根源就在于充满争议。

sentences.en: It wasn't just controversy for controversy's sake.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是为了争议而争议。

sentences.en: Like, they were really trying to say something about America.
sentences.zh: 就像是，他们确实想通过游戏表达对美国的某种看法。

sentences.en: And you can see that in Grand Theft Auto 5.
sentences.zh: 你可以在《侠盗猎车手5》中看到这一点。

sentences.en: You can see it with the characters' relationships to their own phones.
sentences.zh: 你可以从角色与他们手机的关系中看出来。

sentences.en: You know, they might not have Facebook, but they have an app called Life Invader.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们或许没有Facebook，但他们有一个叫“Life Invader”（生活入侵者）的应用程序。

sentences.en: They might not have X, but they have something called Bleeder.
sentences.zh: 他们或许没有X，但他们有一个叫“Bleeder”（流血者）的东西。

sentences.en: There's this real attempt to, like, get a genuine satire of American life right now in a way that, you know, allows you to follow protagonists who are greedy and cynical.
sentences.zh: 这里有一种真正的尝试，即对当下的美国生活进行真正的讽刺，这种方式允许你跟随那些贪婪且愤世嫉俗的主角。

sentences.en: And in going into that world, though, you're not just asked to accept them.
sentences.zh: 然而，在进入那个世界时，你不仅仅是被要求接受他们。

sentences.en: You're asked to reckon with them, which is a very different thing.
sentences.zh: 你是被要求去应对他们，这完全是两码事。

sentences.en: It's something that's special to video games as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是电子游戏独一无二的特殊之处。

sentences.en: It's an arena, especially if you're trying to understand American culture today and say, like, how did we get here?
sentences.zh: 这是一个舞台，特别是如果你想了解今天的美国文化，并探究诸如“我们是怎么走到这一步的”之类的问题时。

sentences.en: It's an arena for you to explore those feelings.
sentences.zh: 这是一个让你去探索那些情感的舞台。

sentences.en: And I think viewers have rewarded them over the years of consistency saying, we're looking at you to tell us what this crazy time we're living in is like.
sentences.zh: 我想观众们多年来用他们始终如一的支持回报了开发者，仿佛在说：我们在指望你来告诉我们，我们所生活的这个疯狂时代究竟是什么样的。

sentences.en: What it means.
sentences.zh: 它意味着什么。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That feels like an unexpected level of cultural insight and criticism to get from a video game.
sentences.zh: 从一款电子游戏中获得这种意料之外的文化洞察力和批判性，感觉真不同寻常。

sentences.en: It's something special, and I think that's why this series has become so popular.
sentences.zh: 这很特别，我想这也是这个系列变得如此受欢迎的原因。

sentences.en: So as compelled and intrigued as I am by everything you're describing here, I think there's no substitute for playing GTA.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管你这里描述的一切都让我感到十分着迷和好奇，但我认为没有什么能取代亲自玩GTA。

sentences.en: And so in front of us is a PlayStation where we are going to play GTA V, and you're going to show me how it is that I hijacked that garbage truck.
sentences.zh: 所以我们面前有一台PlayStation，我们要玩《GTA 5》，你要向我展示我是如何劫持那辆垃圾车的。

sentences.en: It's my honor.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 所以，扎克，我想不到有什么零食比奥利奥更适合我们了。

sentences.zh: 所以我觉得在我们开始玩游戏的时候应该吃一块奥利奥。

sentences.zh: 你知道奥利奥是纯素的吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: Whenever I made it vegan, I go, well, you can eat Oreos.
sentences.zh: 每当我做成纯素的时候，我就会说，哦，你可以吃奥利奥。

sentences.en: It's usually where the conversation ends, because then they get angry and hungry.
sentences.zh: 对话通常到此为止，因为接下来他们既生气又饿了。

sentences.en: Well, maybe I should come up there and practice my backhand on your face!
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许我应该去那里，在你的脸上练习我的反手抽击！

sentences.en: So as you can perhaps hear in the background, our crack team of engineers here at the Sunday Daily have wired up this room so that we can play GTA V.
sentences.zh: 正如你可能在背景中听到的那样，《Sunday Daily》的顶尖工程师团队为这个房间布了线，以便我们能够玩《GTA 5》。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could just describe Zach what's on the screen.
sentences.zh: 我想请你向扎克描述一下屏幕上正在发生什么。

sentences.zh: 我们正开车过桥进入洛圣都市中心，也就是这款游戏里的洛杉矶版本。

sentences.en: And I have just committed Grand Theft Auto.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚犯下了偷车罪。

sentences.en: I am driving a stolen car and looking for trouble.
sentences.zh: 我开着一辆偷来的车，在寻找麻烦。

sentences.zh: 我在找你的垃圾车。

sentences.zh: 哦，你的手机在响。

sentences.en: Someone just called me.
sentences.zh: 刚有人给我打电话。

sentences.en: On the screen.
sentences.zh: 在屏幕上。

sentences.en: I also just jumped out of the car by accident while trying to answer the cell phone.
sentences.zh: 我刚才在试图接听电话时，还一不小心从车里跳了出去。

sentences.en: And now someone is...
sentences.zh: 现在有人……

sentences.en: Has pulled a gun on you.
sentences.zh: 用枪指着你了。

sentences.en: Someone has pulled a gun.
sentences.zh: 有人拔枪了。

sentences.en: Ooh, a cop!

sentences.en: In my reporting, a lot of the places where that's going to happen, though, are not necessarily on the big development costs.

sentences.en: So on average, a triple-A game, you could imagine the budgets are around $200 million.

sentences.en: In those six years, you have to anticipate what viewers will want.

sentences.en: Oftentimes, that gamble does not pay off.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些游戏，如果它们不能立刻火爆起来，其实就没有什么稳步增长一说，对吧？

sentences.en: You can have a cult game, you know, that becomes popular.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可能会有一款小众游戏，然后变得流行起来。

sentences.zh: 但它赚不回3亿美元的预算。

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.zh: 所以在某些情况下，他们索性直接砍掉成本要容易得多。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，还有来自其他工作室的竞争。

sentences.en: Or countries such as China, they're creating games that are free to play.
sentences.zh: 或者像中国这样的国家，他们在开发免费游玩的游戏。

sentences.en: So, like, they're not technically amazing games.
sentences.zh: 所以，从技术上讲，它们可能不是那种惊艳的游戏。

sentences.en: You could play it on your phone, but they're community games.
sentences.zh: 你可以在手机上玩，但它们是社交型的游戏。

sentences.en: So there's things like Roblox, you might have heard of, or Fortnite.

sentences.en: And you don't have to pay to get into it.

sentences.en: So the audience has decreased.

sentences.en: The audience for these prestige games, let's call it, has also gotten older.

sentences.en: So there's a narrowing.

sentences.en: AI has actually built another challenge, which is that to create these games, or to even develop

sentences.en: the machines to play the games, they use the same hardware that AI companies need for their servers.
sentences.zh: 用来玩这些游戏的机器，它们使用的是人工智能公司服务器所需的同款硬件。

sentences.en: So the cost of all that hardware has gone up.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些硬件的成本都上涨了。

sentences.en: Consoles have increased their prices by hundreds of dollars, when usually, within the lifespan of this product, the price is supposed to go down.
sentences.zh: 游戏主机的价格上涨了数百美元，而通常在这个产品的生命周期内，价格本该是下降的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So we should see GTA and the expected success of GTA 6 as an outlier.

sentences.en: The industry is hoping, as, right, the saying is that the rising tide can lift all boats.
sentences.zh: 正如俗话所说，水涨船高，整个行业都在寄希望于此。

sentences.en: People are, people are choosing not to buy them.

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: You know, in terms of what I saw, though, it's what I can speak about is what is also seen in some of the trailers as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就我看到的内容而言，我能谈论的也是预告片里出现过的一些东西。

sentences.en: It's just like they understand that Grand Theft Auto, as much as it is a game that you play, is also a zeitgeiSt.
sentences.zh: 这就好像他们明白，《侠盗猎车手》不仅仅是一个你玩的游玩游戏，它也是一种时代精神。

sentences.en: And they've tried to live up to the expectation of Grand Theft Auto as being sort of like a second life, you know, you in the virtual world.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在努力不辜负《侠盗猎车手》的期望，它就像是你的第二人生，你在虚拟世界中的化身。

sentences.en: If you go to a convenience store, there's going to be like 45 options of different food and drinks that you can get.
sentences.zh: 如果你去一家便利店，里面会有大约45种不同的食物和饮料供你挑选。

sentences.en: Maybe you start vaping while you're in there and you open up one of the magazines in the kiosk.
sentences.zh: 也许你在里面时开始抽电子烟，然后打开报刊亭里的一本杂志。

sentences.en: And there's like a full magazine for you to read through with fake articles inside of it.
sentences.zh: 里面有一整本杂志供你翻阅，里面全都是虚构的文章。

sentences.en: No New York Times, I did check, but their own magazines.
sentences.zh: 没有《纽约时报》，我查过了，但有他们自己的杂志。

sentences.en: So I think it's just like this game is going to show people what is possible when you have what is essentially an unlimited budget.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，这款游戏将向人们展示，当你拥有基本上无限的预算时，什么是可能的。

sentences.en: Earlier in our conversation, you mentioned that GTA V felt like a cultural commentary.
sentences.zh: 在我们刚才的对话中，你提到《GTA 5》感觉像是一种文化评论。

sentences.en: From what you've been able to see of GTA VI, what is the comment it's making about America, about Florida?
sentences.zh: 从你所看到的《GTA 6》中，它对美国、对佛罗里达作出了什么评论？

sentences.en: Well, you know, there are alligators and nudist colonies in the game, which you can experience yourself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，游戏里有短吻鳄和天体村，你可以亲自体验。

sentences.en: You know, they're playing around, certainly, with the stereotype of the Florida man, for example, in the game.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在游戏中肯定拿“佛罗里达男人”的刻板印象开玩笑。

sentences.en: But I do think it, Grand Theft Auto VI, it's really a Bonnie and Clyde story.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，《侠盗猎车手6》本质上是一个雌雄大盗的故事。

sentences.en: Jason, you'll see ya.
sentences.zh: 杰森，你会看到的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 走？

sentences.en: You control these two characters, a man and a woman, who can be in a relationship if you want them to.
sentences.zh: 你控制这两个角色，一男一女，如果你愿意的话，他们可以发展恋爱关系。

sentences.en: And these, like, two criminals that are just trying to make it, you know, in a situation that's incredibly difficult, too.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是两个罪犯，只是想在极其艰难的环境中勉强混过去。

sentences.en: I think there's also elements of the game that lean heavily into surveillance culture.
sentences.zh: 我觉得游戏中还有一些元素大量借鉴了监控文化。

sentences.en: You know, in previous games, if you robbed a store, like, you just gotta get away from the cops.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在之前的游戏中，如果你抢劫了一家店，你只需要摆脱警察就行了。

sentences.en: Here, there are cameras.
sentences.zh: 在这里，有摄像头。

sentences.en: There are a lot of surveillance cameras.
sentences.zh: 有大量的监控摄像头。

sentences.en: There are people with their phones taking videos of you as you're committing a crime.
sentences.zh: 在你犯罪时，有人拿着手机拍你的视频。

sentences.en: So, like, in a way, I think that feels really true to the moment today.
sentences.zh: 所以，某种程度上，我觉得这非常符合当下的现实。

sentences.zh: 这真是个好问题。

sentences.en: I think this game, in terms of it feeling more grounded, also has a little bit of hope in it.

sentences.en: uh, having a game where they fantasize about being these criminals in Florida, um, trying to make a big score.

sentences.en: There is something there, as tainted as it might be, to talk about crimes this way.
sentences.zh: 这里面有某种东西，尽管可能带有瑕疵，却在以这种方式讨论犯罪。

sentences.en: There is an element of hope.
sentences.zh: 这里面包含着一丝希望。
